cause.what_happened: NFE opened near flat at 10.68 and slid all session to a 7.56 low before recovering to 8.46 by about 15:07 ET, on roughly 2.53m shares. That is about 15% of the ~16.3m post-split common and several times the 0.39-0.64m shares a day it traded since the 1-for-50 split. This is the sixth session of a post-reorganisation slide from a 13.69 open on 2026-09-15. No news item, filing or wire story dated 2026-09-22 was found. The pattern fits creditors selling the 10.6m common shares (65%) they received on 2026-09-11, plus the common converging from a 12-20% premium over the preferred's as-converted value toward and through parity, but neither is sourced as the cause.

evidence.claim: Restructuring closed 2026-09-11. Plan creditors received 10,608,922 common shares (65%) and 2,454,936 mandatorily convertible preferred shares, with a 1-for-50 reverse split and new CUSIP. Common still trades as NFE, the preferred as NFEGP.

Post-split daily closes were 12.77 (09-15), 12.51, 12.41, 12.22 (09-18) and 10.82 (09-21). On 09-22 the stock opened 10.68, hit a 7.56 low and was at 8.46 at 15:07 ET on 2,534,794 shares. The series is cut at the screen instant.
NFE was dropped from the S&P Global BMI effective 2026-09-20, after the 2026-09-18 close. That index trade was finished before either down day.

The largest creditor holder, SVP (14.7%), bought NFEGP preferred in the open market at $490 on 09-14 and $505 on 09-16. Implied: the common traded well above the preferred's as-converted value that week.

findings.finding: NFE must file a Form S-1 resale shelf covering the plan creditors' 10.6m common and 2.45m preferred shares no later than 2026-09-25. The filing can land after tonight's close or during 2026-09-23.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The Registration Rights Agreement's Initial Filing Deadline is 10 business days after the 2026-09-11 Closing Date, which is 2026-09-25, and the company must file 'as soon as reasonably practicable'. On 2026-09-22 EDGAR shows no S-1, S-3 or 424B filed, so the filing is still to come. Two of the four remaining filing opportunities (tonight and 09-23) fall inside the window. The size is probability-weighted for that, at roughly 40-50%.
findings.resolves_by: 2026-09-23. The contractual outer date is 2026-09-25, so it may fall outside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior resale-shelf event exists for this post-reorganisation equity. The baseline's 11 comparable falls are all on the pre-restructuring security and carry no supply events. Mean -0.9%, median 0.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: The obligation has been public since 09-11, so the overhang is known. The filing itself is not: it prints a share count and a list of named selling stockholders as a fresh headline, just as the stock trades at post-split lows with creditors apparently still selling. If the price already held it, the stock would have stopped reacting to supply. Instead it fell on 2.5m shares with no news. Effectiveness is at least 30 days after filing, so the filing enables no new sales inside the window. That is why the size is small.
findings.independence: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1749723/000174972326000118/nfe-20260911.htm (the 8-K body restates the 10-business-day S-1 deadline). https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001749723.json shows no registration statement filed through 2026-09-22. Both are the issuer's own filings, so not fully independent.

outside_window.finding: Preferred-versus-common relative value. NFEGP's last print (474.95) implies $10.23 per common share as converted, against 8.46 for the common. The common has swung from a 12-20% premium over parity (09-15 to 09-18) to a ~17% discount. No dated mechanism closes the gap, and the preferred's seniority justifies part of the discount. Filed as an opinion, not a finding.

Undated overhang: the plan creditors' 10,608,922 common shares, about 65% of the class, were issued 2026-09-11 and are likely freely tradable for non-affiliates under a court-sanctioned scheme. Total post-split volume through 15:07 ET on 09-22 is about 5.0m shares, so most creditor supply may still be unsold. There is no date on when it ends, so it is filed as not sizable inside the window.
Effectiveness of the resale S-1: 30 days after filing, or 90 days if the SEC reviews it. That opens registered sales by affiliates such as SVP (14.7%, 19.2m as-converted).
First post-restructuring quarterly report (Q3 2026). The only date is the Zacks cadence estimate of 2026-11-05, not a company-announced date.
